name: ask_human
description: Ask the humans a question without blocking. Creates a question node on the map, assigned to the people in the map. The answer arrives later as a chat message in this conversation. Keep working on other parts meanwhile; do not poll or wait. Use it for decisions only a human can make (priorities, preferences, access), not for facts you can look up.

node_id.description: Put the question under this node. Default: your run's node.

options.description: Suggested answers, if it is multiple choice.

context.description: Markdown background the human needs to answer.
